decision.description: Deterministically bind research_v3/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_INFORMATION_GAIN_SELECTION_EPOCH23_V1.json against research_v3/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_OPPORTUNITY_MAP_EPOCH23_V1.json and research_v3/BROKER_NATIVE_FRONTIER_FEATURE_STORE_EPOCH23_V1.json to select the top-ranked open mechanism family/families (from TREND_MOMENTUM, MEAN_REVERSION, BREAKOUT_VOLATILITY_EXPANSION, CARRY_TERM_STRUCTURE, CROSS_SECTIONAL_RANKING, REGIME_CONTEXT_CONDITIONED, CAUSAL_ML_PREDICTIVE_OR_STATE_MODEL) that were not already ruled CAUSAL_OR_FROZEN_SEMANTIC_SPEC_INVALID or lifetime-consumed, and produce a new non-economic Stage-A candidate design spec (working id V2-C033-CANDIDATE-DESIGN) with mechanism-appropriate breadth chosen from structural heterogeneity/event-independence in the repaired 13W M5 panel, not from any fixed symbol count.

scope_bounds.symbol_universe_source: eligible_post_exclusion frontier (1576 symbols) filtered through PEPPERSTONE_CURRENT_EUR200_SYMBOL_FEASIBILITY_INDEX_V1.json for EUR200 margin feasibility before any breadth is finalized

next_research_state.rationale_for_implementation_ai_false: Selection, binding, and Stage-A spec formalization from already-produced deterministic artifacts (feature store, opportunity map, information-gain ranking, repaired capture) require judgment-guided evidence synthesis, not novel repository machinery; existing Stage-A/capture pipeline capability is sufficient.

objective.goal: Consume the freshly landed EPOCH23 frontier artifacts (feature store, opportunity map, information-gain selection, repaired 13W M5 replacement capture) to formalize the next prospectively-frozen Stage-A candidate design(s) drawn from the open mechanism families, without opening any new economic outcome.
objective.information_gain_rationale: The material delta since last acceptance is precisely the EPOCH23 feature store + opportunity map + information-gain selection built atop a just-repaired and structurally-covered 13W M5 replacement capture. This is the highest-information unconsumed evidence set: it has not yet been used to produce a bound candidate design, it supersedes stale pre-repair captures, and it lets mechanism/breadth selection be driven by ranked information gain rather than by re-litigating already-closed identities (V2-C013..C032) or reusing the outcome-exposed C032 result. Acting on it now avoids wasted attempts on candidates the repaired data has already de-prioritized.
